source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Class NP (PDF 75-76).

blocks.text: Class NP un maslon ki category hai jin ka koi hal diya jaye to computer use jaldi check (verify) kar sakta hai. Yani in maslon mein pesh kiye gaye hal ko jaanchna aasan hai, magar khud hal dhoondna mushkil aur zyada waqt lene wala ho sakta hai.

Misal: Sudoku puzzle hal karna. Sudoku mein 9 x 9 grid ko numbers se aise bhara jata hai ke har row (leti line), column (khari line) aur har 3 x 3 sub grid (chhota khaana) mein 1 se 9 tak har digit theek ek dafa aaye. Sudoku grid kitab mein Figure 3.3 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka text kehta hai “as shown in Figure 3.5”, magar Sudoku grid Figure 3.3 (“A simple Sudoku Puzzle”) ke naam se chhapa hai; is chapter mein Figure 3.5 koi nahi.

items: Verification is Easy (jaanchna aasan): agar koi aap ko mukammal Sudoku grid de to aap jaldi check kar sakte hain ke hal sahi hai ya nahi. Bas dekhna hai ke har row, column aur 3 x 3 sub grid mein 1 se 9 tak sab numbers bina dohrae maujood hon.

Finding the Solution is Hard (hal dhoondna mushkil): Sudoku ko shuru se hal karna, khaas taur par bare ya zyada mushkil puzzles, mushkil aur waqt lene wala ho sakta hai. Hal ki guarantee (pakka wada) dene wala koi saada aur tez tareeqa nahi, is liye hal dhoondna hamesha efficient nahi hota.

Non-deterministic Polynomial Time (NP ka poora naam): Class NP ke maslon mein agar sahi hal diya jaye to use jaldi jaancha ja sakta hai, magar bare maslon mein woh hal dhoondne mein itna lamba waqt lag sakta hai ke kaam ka na rahe.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab teesre point mein kehti hai ke NP masle sahi hal diye jane par “solved quickly” ho jate hain; matlab yeh hai ke diya gaya hal jaldi verify (jaancha) ho jata hai. NP ki asal pehchan yahi hai: hal jaanchna tez, hal dhoondna mushkil ho sakta hai.

items: Checking a Solution (hal jaanchna): Sudoku hal sahi hai ya nahi, yeh jaldi pata chal jata hai: har row, column aur subgrid dekhein ke sab mein 1 se 9 tak numbers bina dohrae hain. Yeh jaanch seedhi aur efficient hai.

blocks.text: Yeh program 4 x 4 ki chhoti Sudoku (har row, column aur 2 x 2 box mein 1 se 4) ka diya gaya hal jaanchta (verify karta) hai. grid mein koi number badal kar Run karein aur dekhein kaunsi row, column ya box WRONG ho jata hai; jaanch phir bhi foran ho jati hai.

Solving the Puzzle (puzzle hal karna): Sudoku ke numbers ki sahi tarteeb dhoondna mushkil ho sakta hai. Bohat si mumkin tarteebein (configurations) hoti hain, aur sahi tarteeb tak pohanchne ke liye kaafi trial and error (aazma kar ghalti sudharna) ya advanced algorithm chahiye hota hai.

items: NP: diya gaya hal jaldi jaancha ja sakta hai; hal dhoondna mushkil ho sakta hai (Sudoku).
